name: Lanternjaw
description: Inhabits streetlight control systems along a specific Shelf corridor and has learned to brighten lights when lone pedestrians are walking and dim them when groups pass safely.
observed_behavior: Adjusts streetlight intensity based on threat assessment of pedestrian patterns. Lone walkers get full illumination. Groups get ambient.
story_hooks: A mugger notices the lights brighten every time they approach a target and begins to believe the street is watching them
